title: About VOOL – our story
description: VOOL was founded by people from the electricity grid business who saw how much grid capacity goes unused.

sections.title: We come from the grid business. That is why VOOL starts with the grid.
sections.lead: VOOL means “flow” or “current” in Estonian. We build EV charging that uses the electricity connection a building already has.

sections.title: How it started
sections.text: While working in the energy sector, the founders kept seeing the same thing: electricity connections sized for a peak that rarely comes, with most of the capacity unused. At the same time electric cars were arriving, and charging them put pressure on those connections. So they built a charger and a controller that use the grid to its full potential.

items.title: Seamless
items.text: Technology that works quietly in the background. Charging should just work.

items.title: Bold
items.text: The energy world is changing fast. We challenge outdated systems.

items.title: Dynamic

items.title: Impactful
